igbo: Ndị isi na-eje ozi nye obodo.

english: The community leader has an important responsibility.
igbo: Onye isi obodo nwere ọrụ dị mkpa.

english: The people elected a new leader.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ họpụtara onye isi ọhụrụ.

english: The leader listens to the people.
igbo: Onye isi ahụ na-ege ndị mmadụ ntị.
Onye ọ bụla kwesịrị ịkwanyere iwu ùgwù.

english: The police officers do their work.
igbo: Ndị uwe ojii na-arụ ọrụ ha.

english: People want to live in peace.

igbo: Ụlọ ọgwụ ọha na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka.

english: The government works to improve life.
igbo: Gọọmenti na-arụ ọrụ iji meziwanye ndụ.

english: Leaders should work for the people.
igbo: Ndị isi kwesịrị ịrụ ọrụ maka ndị mmadụ.
Ndị mmadụ na-atụ anya ezi ọchịchị.

english: The government should listen to the people.
igbo: Gọọmenti kwesịrị ige ndị mmadụ ntị.
Ndị mmadụ nwere ike ikwu echiche ha.

english: The people attended a community meeting.
The meeting took place in the meeting hall.
The government promised to build roads.
The new building is being constructed.
The government uses public money for projects.
igbo: Gọọmenti na-eji ego ọha arụ ọrụ.

english: It is important to use public money properly.
igbo: Ọ dị mkpa iji ego ọha mee ihe nke ọma.

english: People want to know how their money is used.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ chọrọ ịma otú e si eji ego ha.

english: He went to a government office.

igbo: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-enye ọrụ ọha.
Ndị mmadụ na-achọ akwụkwọ dị mkpa.
Ndekọ ahụ nwere ozi dị mkpa.

english: Many young people are looking for jobs.
The government started a training program.

igbo: Mmemme ahụ na-enyere ọtụtụ mmadụ aka.

english: People can participate in the program.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ nwere ike isonye na mmemme ahụ.
Enyemaka ahụ nyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka.

english: Many people depend on small businesses.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ kwesịrị ichekwa gburugburu ebe obibi.

english: The government made a new law.
The new law came into effect.
igbo: Iwu ọhụrụ ahụ malitere ịrụ ọrụ.
Ndị mmadụ mụtara banyere iwu ahụ.

english: It is important to follow the law.
A person who breaks the law may be punished.
igbo: Onye mebiri iwu nwere ike ịta ahụhụ.
Ụlọ ikpe na-eleba anya n'okwu iwu.
Onye ọka iwu na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka.
Ndị mmadụ chọrọ ikpe ziri ezi.

english: Justice is important in a community.
igbo: Ikpe ziri ezi dị mkpa n'obodo.
Ndị ọrụ ahụike na-enyere ndị ọrịa aka.
Mkpọsa ahụike na-enye ozi dị mkpa.
Ndị mmadụ kwesịrị ịgbaso ndụmọdụ ahụike.
Agụmakwụkwọ na-enyere obodo aka ito eto.

english: Leaders make plans for the future.
igbo: Ndị isi na-eme atụmatụ maka ọdịnihu.

english: The plan is for community development.
igbo: Atụmatụ ahụ bụ maka mmepe obodo.

english: Development requires the support of the people.
igbo: Mmepe chọrọ nkwado nke ndị mmadụ.

english: People work together with the government.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-arụkọ ọrụ na gọọmenti.

english: Good governance makes a community strong.
igbo: Ezi ọchịchị na-eme ka obodo sie ike.

english: The government and the people should work together.
igbo: Gọọmenti na ndị mmadụ kwesịrị ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ.
